title: B2C online store for physical goods (EU)

scope.category: B2C online store for physical goods (the customer-facing order API)

capabilities.name: Order history
capabilities.why: Customers need to find what they bought, for returns and records.

capabilities.name: Order status and delivery tracking
capabilities.why: Customers ask where their order is; the trader must inform them about delivery arrangements.

capabilities.name: Order cancellation and withdrawal
capabilities.why: Consumers may withdraw from a distance contract within 14 days without giving a reason.

capabilities.name: Order confirmation and receipts
capabilities.why: The consumer must receive confirmation of the contract on a durable medium.

regulations.name: Consumer Rights Directive (2011/83/EU)
regulations.appliesWhen: selling to consumers in the EU
obligations: a 14-day right of withdrawal from distance contracts
confirmation of the contract on a durable medium

regulations.name: GDPR right of access (Art. 15)
regulations.appliesWhen: processing personal data of people in the EU
obligations: give a customer a copy of their personal data on request

metrics.name: Order lookups answered without support contact
metrics.why: Status questions are a top support cost when tracking is missing.

weaknesses.name: Broken object-level authorization on order endpoints
weaknesses.failure: A customer reads another customer's order by changing the id in the URL.
weaknesses.lookFor: an order fetched by id without comparing its owner with the caller
